<!--
Before you open this: the way to change Ultimate is to ask it to change itself. Extensions, agents, skills and
settings in a project's `.ultimate/` or in `~/.ultimate/` survive updates; edits to the clone conflict with every update.

Clear-cut fixes or improvements to the core may be merged. Feature pull requests stay open and unmerged as reference
implementations, titled "Feature: …" and labelled `feature`, so anyone who wants to solve the same problem can borrow
from them: `gh pr list --repo HazAT/ultimate --label feature`. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->
